prompt:
Create a production macOS app icon as a PNG with a transparent background (actual alpha channel). Use case: logo-brand.
One simple, elegant geometric sea turtle emblem in mint jade (#7ADFB4) on a rounded-square midnight navy (#151D29) tile. Square canvas. Tile centered with 8% transparent margins around it and large smooth rounded corners. Turtle centered on tile, smooth oval shell, small oval head, four short rounded flippers and a tiny tail. No face, no eyes. The shell is ONE continuous shape with a dark negative-space Git branch symbol cut through it: three round nodes connected with a vertical stem and one diagonal branch. No shell segments, no scales, no seams. Almost flat, with only understated soft shading. Clear balanced silhouette readable at 32 pixels. Restrained premium native desktop brand.
No text, no lettering, no checkerboard pattern, no background scene, no backdrop color outside the rounded square, no decoration. Actual transparent canvas around the tile.
